name: @thetis/workflows
description: Workflows: graphs of prompts, tool calls, parsing and branches that run unattended in your own conversations, with a visual editor and a run view.

concurrency.help: How many runs go at once. Runs that share a working tree must not overlap, so the default is one.

costCapUsd.help: The cost cap for a run whose workflow names none, in US dollars. A run that reaches it is stopped and handed to you.

places.label: Workflows
places.hint: Build workflows and watch their runs
